fields.pmHelp: Pick the column that holds the project manager — shown on the summary card

dayoff.title: Day-off vacations board
dayoff.description: Map the vacations board managed by the Day-off app — the absence source of truth. Approved personal absences zero the employee's capacity; mandatory company days zero everyone

fields.boardHelp: The board where Day-off stores absence requests and company days. Changing the board resets the column and label mappings below
fields.employeeHelp: The people column holding the requesting employee — must resolve to the same monday user as the Employees board
fields.kindHelp: The status column distinguishing personal requests from company-wide days
fields.kindLabelsHelp: Stored as stable label IDs — renaming the labels on the board later is safe
fields.typeHelp: Optional — the status column with the absence type (vacation, sick…), shown in availability tooltips
fields.mandatoryHelp: Company days with this box checked close the office and zero capacity for everyone; unchecked days are display-only. Without this mapping every company day is display-only
fields.approvalRequiredHelp: On — only requests whose approval status is in the approved set reduce capacity. Off — every personal absence counts, including pending and rejected ones
fields.approvedValuesHelp: Pick the labels meaning the request was approved (required while the toggle is on)
fields.approvalColumnHelp: The approval-lifecycle column on the board. Required when the approval policy is ON — and recommended always: without it rejected requests cannot be excluded.
fields.rejectedValuesHelp: Requests carrying these labels are always excluded from availability math — even when the approval policy is OFF. They remain visible only inside the Day-off app.
